Sobre a vaga

Location: Avenida Paulista, São Paulo, Brazil

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and applications using Java and Spring Boot
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code following best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software solutions
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues across the development lifecycle
  • Provide timely updates on progress, challenges, and deliverables
  • Proactively identify and propose solutions to technical problems

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in related frield
  • 1–3 years of professional Java development experience
  • Strong proficiency in Java JDK and Spring Boot framework
  • Solid experience with MyBatis or similar ORM frameworks
  • Strong SQL skills, including query optimization and index management
  • Familiarity with middleware technologies such as Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or Elasticsearch (nice to have)
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently and manage tasks with minimal supervision
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Able to communicate in English

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Opportunity to work on scalable, high-impact applications
  • Collaborative and growth-oriented team environment

We are a global HR services company specializing in international workforce solutions for businesses operating across borders. We help organizations hire, manage, and support talent worldwide by simplifying the complexities of global employment, compliance, and people operations. Our services cover the full employee lifecycle, including international hiring, payroll administration, benefits coordination, compliance with local labor laws, and ongoing HR support. By combining regional expertise with standardized global processes, we enable companies to expand into new markets quickly and confidently. With a strong understanding of diverse employment regulations and cultural practices, we act as a trusted partner to our clients—reducing risk, improving efficiency, and allowing them to focus on growing their business while we manage their global HR needs.
